CHANGES (list ALL modifications, one or multiple):

Change #1: [Category: Training Strategy]
- What: In model_design, replace the training history profile with a target-excluded profile: remove every occurrence of the sampled positive item from the exponentially weighted history average and renormalize the remaining weights, using a zero profile when nothing remains. Implement this efficiently by subtracting the positive item’s aggregated weighted embedding from the existing profile; keep inference profiles unchanged because their prediction targets are unseen.
- Why: Training currently includes the positive item inside its own history representation, creating a direct self-similarity shortcut that is unavailable when ranking held-out items.

---

WHY current solution limited:
- Root cause: The BPR objective can improve by increasing similarity to a positive embedding already present in the profile instead of learning relationships between distinct items.
- Evidence: training_vectors() builds profiles from complete training histories while positives are sampled from those same histories; Electronics HR@10 also falls from the SASRec baseline’s 0.42 to 0.33, although this result alone does not establish the cause.

HOW these changes address it:
- Mechanism: Target exclusion forces the history contribution to explain a positive through other observed items, better matching held-out recommendation while retaining the learned user representation and graph propagation.
- Expected improvement: Predict higher Electronics HR@10 and macro-average HR@10 above 0.5537; treat these as hypotheses to test using the unchanged pinned validation benchmark.
- Synergy (if multiple changes): Not applicable; this is one controlled change to training profile construction.

KEEP UNCHANGED (must explicitly list):
- Random seed: preprocessing seed=0 and training seed=42.
- Data split: identical supplied training and validation splits; no hidden test access.
- Data source: os.environ['GAGC_DATA_DIR']; retain all four categories and dataset routing.
- Model: two-layer LightGCN, 64-dimensional embeddings, history coefficient 0.5, and history half-life of 10 interactions.
- Optimization: existing BPR loss, regularization, optimizer, sampling, epoch limit, and checkpoint selection.
- Evaluation: 200 validation users/category, 99 unique negatives, evaluation seed=42, and macro-average HR@10.
- Inference and artifacts: retain the existing trained-model forward pass, predictor writer, and trial-local working directory; the host performs held-out evaluation.
